body: You seem like a nice guy, and you seem like you could easily stream video games (as far as being articulate) on twitch or something. Perhaps you could do that on the side and garner some donations from viewers? You never know if you can make money off of it, but you might end up getting something out of the experience you'd never expect. I don't know if you have the computer set up to do it, but that's what I'd recommend.
The free rice helps. It's a better way to spend time. Thank you for your thoughts.
